values: IADSSL-1792 - Depository Account Category Update
Common Preconditions

1. User is signed in to Sage Intacct.
2. The correct Depository Management entity is selected.
3. Depository Management is enabled.
4. The user has permission to manage depository account categories and accounts.
5. Required document sequences and master records are active.

CREATE  (2 test cases)
Create an unassigned category with an available document sequence
Refer to Common Preconditions above.

Category: QA-I1792-UNASSIGNED
Document sequence: QA-I1792-SEQ-A (available)
Status: Active

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct with the test user.
2. Navigate to Applications > Depository Management > Account category.
3. Prepare the test data: Confirm QA-I1792-SEQ-A is not used by another category..
4. Create QA-I1792-UNASSIGNED and select QA-I1792-SEQ-A.
5. Save the category.
6. Review the confirmation, record, related depository account, and audit history applicable to this scenario.
The category is created successfully with QA-I1792-SEQ-A and remains unassigned to any depository account.

Allow an unassigned category to change to a unique available document sequence
Refer to Common Preconditions above. The category is unassigned and two unused sequences exist.

Category: QA-I1792-UNASSIGNED-EDITED
Original sequence: QA-I1792-SEQ-A
New sequence: QA-I1792-SEQ-C (unused)

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct with the test user.
2. Navigate to Applications > Depository Management > Account category.
3. Prepare the test data: Confirm QA-I1792-SEQ-C is not used by any other category and open the unassigned category..
4. Change Document sequence from QA-I1792-SEQ-A to the unique available value QA-I1792-SEQ-C.
5. Save the category.
6. Review the confirmation, record, related depository account, and audit history applicable to this scenario.
The unique available sequence change saves successfully; QA-I1792-SEQ-C is displayed on View and QA-I1792-SEQ-A becomes available for another category.

Do not allow an unassigned category to change to a document sequence used by another category
Refer to Common Preconditions above. The edited category is unassigned; another category owns the target sequence.

Edited category: QA-I1792-UNASSIGNED-EDITED
Current sequence: QA-I1792-SEQ-C
Used target: QA-I1792-SEQ-B
Owner: QA-I1792-SEQ-OWNER

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct with the test user.
2. Navigate to Applications > Depository Management > Account category.
3. Prepare the test data: Open the unassigned category and confirm QA-I1792-SEQ-B is already used by QA-I1792-SEQ-OWNER..
4. Attempt to change Document sequence to the already-used value QA-I1792-SEQ-B.
5. Save if the picker permits the value.
6. Review the confirmation, record, related depository account, and audit history applicable to this scenario.

The unassigned category is not changed to QA-I1792-SEQ-B: the used sequence is absent from the picker or Save is rejected with only the duplicate-sequence validation. No assignment-specific warning is shown, and QA-I1792-SEQ-C remains unchanged.
